title: KCSAN: data-race in tcp_sendmsg_locked / tcp_stream_memory_free
two_threads_summary: KCSAN-reported two-context race. KCSAN: data-race in tcp_sendmsg_locked / tcp_stream_memory_free
audit_notes: Subject: 'tcp: annotate tp->write_seq lockless reads'. Pre-classifier PROBABLY_GOOD (real synchronization primitives on + lines).
fix_commit_message:
0f31746452e6793ad6271337438af8f4defb8940
tcp: annotate tp->write_seq lockless reads

There are few places where we fetch tp->write_seq while
this field can change from IRQ or other cpu.

We need to add READ_ONCE() annotations, and also make
sure write sides use corresponding WRITE_ONCE() to avoid
store-tearing.

Signed-off-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
